about.title: One roof, one list, one trip
about.lead: Wafiq Superstores brings groceries, pantry staples, household goods, cleaning supplies, baby care and personal care together in a single shop.
about.bodyOne: The idea is simple. Most households run on the same forty or fifty items, and most of those trips end up split across three different shops. We built Wafiq so the whole list sits in one place — the chai and the biscuits, the masala and the mop, the shampoo and the nappies.
about.bodyTwo: This site is our shelf, published. It is a catalogue, not a shop: browse what we carry, check the pack sizes, then visit a branch. Nothing is sold online.
about.valueOneBody: {{aisles}} aisles covering the full household list, so one visit is enough.

about.valueThreeBody: Check the shelf online first, then come in for what you need.
